responsibility: This is the main recursive-descent parser for GNU C and Objective-C source text. It initializes reserved-word tokens, maintains the parser state and lookahead buffers, parses translation units, declarations, statements, expressions, pragmas, and GNU extensions, coordinates with declaration/type-checking code to build C trees, tracks deferred incomplete-record diagnostics, and also contains front-end entry points for special function bodies written as embedded RTL or routed to the textual GIMPLE parser.
same_name_distinction: This .c file is the implementation side of the C parser pair: it defines the parser state object, parser initialization, recursive-descent parsing logic, translation-unit parsing, and special body parsing paths for textual GIMPLE or embedded RTL, while gcc/c/c-parser.h provides the token definitions, enums, inline token tests, and parser API declarations used by other front-end code.
